Hosted phase workflow
decisions.decision: Every ordinary source phase starts from latest main, uses a work branch, must pass required windows-latest GitHub Actions, merges only when green, and revalidates main before the next phase.
decisions.rationale: Make clean public-clone reproducibility and hosted regression evidence the development floor while preserving Windows-only MT5 boundaries.

decisions.title: Final runtime acceptance is deferred
decisions.decision: Owner-PC fresh database, real MT5/MetaEditor, broker/data-root, filesystem deployment and browser E2E are performed only after the GitHub development roadmap is complete; GitHub Actions cannot claim those runtime facts.
decisions.rationale: Prevent ordinary source CI from being misrepresented as production MT5/runtime evidence.

decisions.title: Public source-only repository boundary
decisions.decision: The public repository contains source, deterministic governance and synthetic test fixtures only; private/runtime databases, evidence, artifacts, datasets, credentials, terminal data, logs and local dependency/build outputs are excluded.
decisions.rationale: Keep a public clean clone reproducible without leaking private state or coupling tests to Owner runtime artifacts.

decisions.title: GitHub-hosted development authority
decisions.decision: GitHub main exact SHA in maxqstudio/max-trading-agent is source authority; GitHub Actions on windows-latest is the hosted build/test authority for ordinary development phases; Owner PC plus real MetaTrader 5 is reserved for final runtime/E2E acceptance after GitHub development closure.
decisions.rationale: Separate reproducible public-source development from the hardware/broker/runtime boundary that GitHub Actions cannot prove.

decisions.title: Windows-only hosted CI
decisions.decision: MAX application CI remains Windows-only and must not add Linux/macOS matrix coverage merely for platform breadth.
decisions.rationale: The production execution boundary is MetaTrader 5 on Windows; hosted CI should validate the supported application platform without pretending to emulate real MT5 runtime.

decisions.title: Adopt deterministic-LF Skill Workflow authority
decisions.decision: MAX adopts Skill Workflow 1f9b48b9a3bf29bf2929a7d38b1ec9a645dfb720; the upstream delta from 9e22feddb8f94e8c0f1af6a33e14b64de5068f8f enforces byte-exact LF writes for acceptance.json and validates that contract in STRICT selftest.
decisions.rationale: Current-main governance authority must be adopted without MAX-local compatibility patches.

decisions.title: R01 binds to latest accepted current R00
decisions.decision: R01 derives its parent from the latest Research project in current runtime authority and fails closed unless that R00 is terminal PASS_WAITING_OWNER with verified frozen integrity and exact Research/Strategy/parent-authority bindings. Retired previous-epoch IDs are not product constants.
decisions.rationale: This preserves immutable R00 lineage while allowing future fresh epochs to proceed without source edits or hardcoded Research/Champion identities.

decisions.title: R02 source foundation is non-executing
decisions.decision: Hosted R02 source work may define deterministic candidate identity/planning contracts and read-only preflight before a real R01 result exists, but it must not expose a start endpoint, persist scientific candidate outcomes, train models, qualify candidates, or bypass the later explicit Owner R02 authorization.
decisions.rationale: Build and test the control contract early without confusing source readiness with scientific execution or qualification authority.
